skill.summary: Plan travel price monitoring and visa or document reminders with safe, read-only guidance. Use when a user wants price drop alerts, travel checklists, or visa timelines without booking or payment actions.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of travel-price-drop-visa-reminder.

- Provides safe, read-only guidance for travel price monitoring and visa/document reminders.
- Supports planning price thresholds, alert cadences, and document timelines.
- Avoids booking, payment, legal, or visa-processing actions.
- Includes clear best/use-case guidance and safety guardrails.
- Relies only on official or user-provided data sources; does not handle personal documents or sensitive data.
